entities.summary: Zhao Jingshen (1902–1985) was a popular Chinese novelist. He taught at Fudan University in Shanghai. Between July 1946 and January 1949, he edited three weekly newspaper columns on vernacular literature: one in the Shenzhen ribao ; a second in Dawan bao ; and a third in Zhongyang ribao.
